match_winner#mw_misfiled_series.what_would_resolve: Fetch live rules_primary for KXATPGAME and KXWTAGAME and align the round-winner series filing across the two archetypes.

season_ranking_and_majors#sr_finals_qual.description: KXATPFINALSQUAL and KXWTAFINALSQUAL now have rules text: Yes on qualifying, and Yes even if a qualified player does not compete. Still open: whether an alternate promoted after a withdrawal 'qualifies', the exact cut-off date, and the ATP Grand Slam champion exemption (a current-year major winner finishing 9-20 in the Race takes the 8th place, outside knowledge). ten.remaining_race_arithmetic's catalog measurement still says a withdrawn qualifier is replaced by the next alternate and leaves the Slam-champion rule unmodelled; for these contracts withdrawal after qualifying must not reduce the qualifier's P(Yes).
season_ranking_and_majors#sr_finals_qual.what_would_resolve: Read the ATP and WTA Finals qualification rulebook sections and Kalshi settlement precedents for alternates; amend the race-arithmetic measurement in the catalog accordingly.
season_ranking_and_majors#sr_finals_qual.classification_rationale: The catalog measurement is demonstrably wrong: ten.remaining_race_arithmetic replaces a withdrawn qualifier with the next alternate, but the KXATPFINALSQUAL/KXWTAFINALSQUAL rules say Yes even if a qualified player does not compete. It also omits the verified ATP rule that a current-year Grand Slam champion finishing 8th-20th in the Race takes the 8th place instead of the 8th-ranked player, which adds a required input (current-year major winners) to the ATP race computation.
season_ranking_and_majors#sr_finals_qual.catalog_action: Rewrite ten.remaining_race_arithmetic for the Finals-qual series: P(Yes)=P(top-7, or 8th subject to the Grand Slam champion 8-20 rule) without a withdrawal reduction; add current-year major winners (ten.career_major_count_state) as an input for ATP; confirm the WTA rule, cut-off date and alternate settlement from the ATP/WTA rulebook chapters.
